items.source: Create a concrete instance of AbstractExceptionHandlerMethodResolver that finds exception handling methods based on some criteria, for example, based on the presence of @MessageExceptionHandler.
items.translation: 创建一个 `AbstractExceptionHandlerMethodResolver` 的具体实例，该实例根据某些标准（例如基于是否存在 `@MessageExceptionHandler`）查找异常处理方法。

items.source: By default, SimpleRouteMatcher is used, backed by AntPathMatcher with "." as separator. For greater efficiency consider using the PathPatternRouteMatcher from spring-web instead.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用由带有"."作为分隔符的AntPathMatcher支持的SimpleRouteMatcher。为了提高效率，请考虑改用spring-web中的PathPatternRouteMatcher。

items.source: Payloads for incoming messages are decoded through the configured setDecoders(List) decoders, with the help of PayloadMethodArgumentResolver.
items.translation: 入站消息的负载通过配置的 setDecoders(List) 解码器进行解码，并借助 PayloadMethodArgumentResolver。

items.source: There is no default handling for return values but AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setReturnValueHandlerConfigurer(ReturnValueHandlerConfigurer) can be used to configure custom return value handlers. Subclasses may also override initReturnValueHandlers() to set up default return value handlers.
items.translation: 默认情况下没有对返回值进行处理，但可以使用 AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setReturnValueHandlerConfigurer(ReturnValueHandlerConfigurer) 来配置自定义的返回值处理器。子类也可以重写 initReturnValueHandlers() 来设置默认的返回值处理器。

items.source: By default DefaultFormattingConversionService is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用DefaultFormattingConversionService。

items.source: Subclasses should also take into account custom argument types configured via AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setArgumentResolverConfigurer(ArgumentResolverConfigurer).
items.translation: 子类还应考虑通过 AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setArgumentResolverConfigurer(ArgumentResolverConfigurer) 配置的自定义参数类型。

items.source: Subclasses should also take into account custom return value types configured via AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setReturnValueHandlerConfigurer(ReturnValueHandlerConfigurer).
items.translation: 子类还应考虑通过 AbstractMethodMessageHandler.setReturnValueHandlerConfigurer(ReturnValueHandlerConfigurer) 配置的自定义返回值类型。

items.source: Note: This is completely optional. The mapping metadata for a subclass may support neither direct lookups, nor String based destinations.
items.translation: 注意： 这完全是可选的。子类的映射元数据可能既不支持直接查找，也不支持基于字符串的目标地址。

items.source: Use this method to register a MessagingAdviceBean that may contain globally applicable @MessageExceptionHandler methods.
items.translation: 使用此方法注册一个可能包含全局适用的 @MessageExceptionHandler 方法的 MessagingAdviceBean。
